action.reason: blocking smell "reflect-spec-defect": reflection gate: AC3 says 'given a location has no stock records, when the operator views that location on the home screen' — implying the home screen has per-location navigation or filtering. But AC1 describes the home screen as a flat global table of all stock records, with no location filter declared. 'Views that location' introduces an undescribed UI affordance (location selector / route param). T23 compounds the ambiguity by saying 'the live API returns no records for a location' (location-scoped query) rather than 'returns no records at all' (empty table). As written, AC3 either (a) contradicts AC1 by requiring a per-location view that AC1 doesn't expose, or (b) means 'the table is entirely empty' — but if (b), the AC wording and test precondition must say so. The Driver cannot determine which behavior to build without clarification.
